text: pajjotasuttaṃ [68] kati lokasmi pajjotā yehi loko pakāsati 1 bhagavantaṃ puṭṭhumāgamma kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayanti . [69] cattāro loke pajjotā pañcamettha na vijjati divā tapati ādicco rattimābhāti candimā atha aggi divārattiṃ tattha tattha pakāsati 2 sambuddho tapataṃ seṭṭho esā ābhā anuttarāti . sattamaṃ
